title: Viral proteome dimers (AFDB pandemic preparedness)
ids: UniProt accession; polyprotein mature peptides as <accession>_p<md5(sequence)[:10]>

source.citation: Han Y, Narain R, et al. (2026). Systematic exploration of predicted quaternary structures within pandemic-relevant viral proteomes. Models: AlphaFold Database / EMBL-EBI FTP (alphafold/collaborations/nvda/pandemic_prep), CC BY 4.0.
source.method: AlphaFold-Multimer v3, ONE model per pair (model_1_multimer_v3), 12 recycles, Logan-enriched unpaired MSA (NVIDIA BioNeMo / OpenFold); rescored with lis.py. iLIS cutoffs were calibrated on best-of-5 models, so at the same cutoff this screen is less sensitive (transient interfaces that only some models capture are missed); a low iLIS here means "not seen by model_1".

folded.note: identical sequence pairs in related strains are served on every strain, counted once
